caption: The drawing depicts an object composed of two main materials and textures. The upper portion is a rigid, curved structure with a woven pattern in shades of brown and tan, bordered by a light tannish trim. This woven section forms a semi-cylindrical shape with vertical and horizontal patterning. Attached to the bottom of this structure is a gathered piece of semi-transparent, brownish fabric, which drapes downward in loose folds and extends to nearly the same length as the woven portion. A wide band of the same brown fabric runs from the top center to the gathered section, covering part of the woven pattern. The background is plain and light beige, and the lower left corner bears the artist’s signature, "FRITZ BOEHMER."
title: Zoar Summer Bonnet
